arabic text: JAFAR E TAYYAR HAI\nHAIDER E KARRAR HAI\nAUN O MUHAMMAD MERE
SHAH SE BOLI BAHAN, AY MERE BHAYI SUNOY\nJANG KE MAIDAN ME, PEHLE INHE BHEJDO\nHONE KO TUM PAR FIDA, HAR GHARI TAYAAR HAIN
english translation text: B. ZAINAB SAID TO IMAM, O’ MY BROTHER\nSEND THEM ON THE BATTLFIELD FIRST!\nTHEY ARE READY TO SACRIFICE THEIR LIVES FOR YOU

arabic text: INKI HUWI PARWARISH, SAAYE ME ABBAS KE\nRAN ME INHE DEKH KE, KYUN NA YE ZAINAB KAHE\nLASHKARE SHABBIR ME, AKS ALAMDAAR HAIN
english translation text: THEY HAVE BEEN BROUGHT UP UNDER THE WATCH OF ABBAS\nWHY SHOULD ZAINAB NOT BE PROUD OF THEM ON THE BATTLEFIELD\nIN THE ARMY OF HUSSAIN, THEY ARE THE REFLECTION OF ABBAS

arabic text: PYAAS KI SHIDAT SE HAIN, KAT RAHE QALB O JIGAR\nPANI NAHI LAENGE, APNE LABON TAK MAGAR\nSAAMNE NOW LAKH KE, HAIDERI TALWAAR HAI
english translation text: THROUGH THE EXTREME THIRST, THEY’RE BEING PUT TO THE ULTIMATE TEST\nHOWEVER, THEY WILL NOT DRINK WATER (BECAUSE HUSSAIN IS THIRSTY)\nIN FRONT OF THIS HUGE OPPOSITION, THEY ARE HAIDERI WARRIORS

arabic text: KEHTI THI BINTE ALI, FIDYA E SHABIR HAIN\nJURAT O HIMMAT KI YEH, BOLTI TASWEER HAIN\nRAAH ME BAATIL KE YEH, AAHNI DEEWAR HAIN
english translation text: ZAINAB SAID, THEY WERE BROUGHT UP TO BE SACRIFICED FOR HUSSAIN (AND ISLAM)\nTHEY ARE BRAVERY AND COURAGE PERSONFIED\nTHEY ARE A STRONG WALL – OPPOSING THAT WHICH IS WRONG

arabic text: KHOON E ABU TALIBI, INKI RAGON ME RAWAA(N)\nAAJ MITA DENGE YEH, ZULM KA NAAM O NISHAA\nBAYAT E FASIQ SE YEH, SHAH KA INKAAR HAIN
english translation text: THE BLOOD OF ABU TALIB RUNS THROUGH THEIR VEINS\nTODAY, THEY WILL DEMOLISH OPPRESSION AND SUFFERING\nTHEY REPRESENT HUSSAIN’S STANCE AGAINST INJUSTICE

arabic text: NANA HAIN SHERE KHUDA, DADA HAIN FAKHRE ZAMAN\nBAAAP SHUJAA E ARAB, SAANI E ZAHRA HAI MAA\nAALA HASAB AUR NASAB, SAAHIBE KIRDAAR HAIN
english translation text: THEIR (MATERNAL) GRANDFATHER WAS THE LION OF GOD, AND THEIR (PATERNAL) GRANDFATHER WAS THE PRIDE OF HIS ERA\nTHEIR FATHER WAS THE BRAVE FROM THE ARABS, AND THEIR MOTHER IS A REFLECTION OF ZAHRA\nSUCH LOFTY HISTORIES –THEY HOLD RESPECTABLE CHARACTERS

arabic text: BA KHUDA SALMAN HAI, MERA AQEEDA YEHI\nAATI HAIN MAJLIS ME JO, PURSE KO BINTE ALI\nSAATH ME MADAR KE YEH, DONO AZADAR HAIN
english translation text: BY GOD, SALMAN, I BELIEVE THIS\nTHE DAUGHTER OF ALI JOINS OUR MAJALIS\nALONG WITH THEIR MOTHER, BOTH OF THESE BOYS ARE ALSO AZADARS
